newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's M.C. Bank H1 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's M.C. Bank H1 profit seen up.

text.p: First-half pre-tax profits of the privatised Muslim Commercial Bank are expected to rise sharply due to improved business, dealers said on Monday.
"The bank's performance is healthy," dealer Manocher Jamal of Taurus Securities Ltd said on the eve of an MCB board meeting to consider first-half accounts to June 30.
A broker at the Karachi Stock Exchange said MCB's first-half pre-tax profit might rise more than 70 percent over the year-ago period, saying its overall performance had been extremely good.
MCB's 10-rupee stock ended 0.25 rupees down at 32.50 on Monday.

Dealer Asif Jan said MCB had recovered some of its bad loans, boosting first-half earnings. "Its overall performance is much better than the other two big banks," he said, referring to state-run Habib Bank Ltd and National Bank of Pakistan.
